depth_convention: no depth device in P00; metric depth and its validity are P01-C work
pixel_convention: top-left origin written as [column, row]; the column axis runs along the body's rightward (-y) axis and the row axis runs downward (-z), because a Webots camera's optical axis is its own +x
source: declared for the compat scene from the Webots world and proto; not measured
validated_limits: declared from the scene file, not measured: intrinsics follow from the declared 1.0472 rad field of view and 640x480 images, distortion is assumed zero, and the rig geometry is the placement written in scenarios/compat/protos/Iris.proto. Validated operating limits and a measured calibration are P01-C work.
